label: Lending a key: how many people, what the owner may see of a borrower's work, the usage table, bills

params.name: keys_shared_max
params.label: People one key may be lent to at once

params.name: holder_label_max
params.label: Longest name the borrower may give a borrowed key

params.name: usage_max_page_size
params.label: Most usage rows one page may ask for

params.name: usage_sort_key
params.label: Usage table sorts on this field

params.name: usage_search_keys
params.label: Fields the usage search box looks in

params.name: owner_sees_chars
params.label: Characters of a borrower's activity name the key owner sees

params.name: owner_sees_tail
params.label: Put after a shortened activity name

params.name: markup_max_pct
params.label: Most a lender may add on top (per cent)

description_nl: keys_shared_max: how many people one key may be lent to at once. holder_label_max: the borrower names a borrowed key for themselves (usually the owner's name) - this is how long that may be. usage_page_size, usage_max_page_size, usage_sort_key, usage_sort_desc, usage_search_keys: the usage table. owner_sees_chars and owner_sees_tail: a key's owner sees only this much of what a borrower called their work - enough to recognise a run they are billed for, not the whole title; the borrower sees it in full and can cross-check the bill. bills_kept, bill_note_max: bills. markup_max_pct: the largest mark-up a lender may type. report_page_size: lines on one page of the lender's shared-key report.
weight_basis: Every limit and every column of key sharing. Edit here, never in Python.
